scope: Diagnostic only; frozen production, AOEM, tester and policies unchanged. No new TPS acceptance. No raw system ETL/PDB/all-system CSV included.
sample_denominator: Every percentage uses all raw SampledProfile events for the selected original PID/TID, including samples absent from the xperf stack report. Inclusive scopes overlap: do not add them or add exclusive leaves to their parent. 1ms CPU samples are not end-to-end latency or elapsed wall stages.
symbol_limits: Microsoft OS PDBs and the matching frozen native/AOEM PDBs resolve most leaves. Public-only optimized Rust PDB names can label unnamed/inline functions incorrectly; rpc::error is not evidence HTTP/JSON processing. Exact RVAs, unwind boundaries, direct calls and source callsites are used for the native admission interpretation. Raw-sample versus stack-hit difference is retained unassigned, not silently renormalized.
input_identity: one in-memory signed corpus replayed byte-identically across CPU/GPU/CPU

exact_address_symbol_review.scope: Read-only exact-address verification on frozen candidate-v4 node PE and matching PDB. Raw system traces stay private. No production source changed.
exact_address_symbol_review.pdb_limit: llvm-pdbutil dump --symbols --modi=1 reports module stream not present. llvm-symbolizer resolves nearest public names but returns empty FileName and Line=0; no private function/inline source identity can be inferred from a public label alone.

raw_exact_address_crosscheck.method: Stream original PerfInfo SampledProfile/Stack records, target PID9360/TID33260; each inclusive range counted once per sample event, no symbol names used. Stack-only missing/unrepresented samples remain in raw denominator.
raw_exact_address_crosscheck.limit: The unnamed admission range is one verified machine function, not the complete nearest-public rpc::error aggregate; other private functions can share that label. These raw-address counts do not replace the parent report normalization or missing-stack accounting.

native_admission_alias.actual_error_disassembly: At RVA0x5c8507/0x5c850e/0x5c8549/0x5c854d machine instructions store jsonrpc and 2.0 literals, confirming actual JSON error body at its own entry.
native_admission_alias.raw_stack_source: workload-round-0-perf-dump.csv; same caller chain also observed at sample18755us
native_admission_alias.conclusion: The raw UcaBatchStateRead caller is outside the actual JSON error body, inside an unnamed native admission function. Treat the aggregate rpc::error bucket as a nearest-public attribution artifact, not proof of HTTP/JSON processing. Current source/control-call correspondence identifies native admission, but exact original private/inline name is unavailable in this PDB. Do not claim all grouped hits belong to a source line.

secure_aad_alias.machine_code_correspondence: Helper builds Vec<u8>, appends an8-byte length38 then the domain literal ending frame-v1, version/session/peer/sequence/nonce fields, and grows Vec during append. These match the existing secure_frame_aad_v1 body rather than RLP header payload generation.
source_correspondence: crates/novovm-network/src/product_overlay.rs:771 secure_frame_aad_v1 builds Vec and appends the exact envelope fields
secure_aad_alias.conclusion: The raw sampled return address0x1f72fcf is beyond the named eth_rlpx function and within the actual shared AAD-preparation helper. This is native NovoRUDP authenticated-envelope preparation/allocation, not evidence of foreign-chain/HTTP/WSS traffic.

scheduling.scope: 4.9s interior slice after both FirstReliableCSwitch timestamps; context-switch wall intervals, not CPU useful work. Missing-pair interval left Unknown; ReadyThread racing before switchout does not imply on-CPU waiting. Waiting reason is scheduler classification, not wait callsite. DPC/ISR not excluded; no corresponding events captured. Leading/trailing clip makes interval maxima bounded, not full lifetimes.

limits: Single Windows machine with four native processes and loopback; kernel send cost includes local receive delivery, not wire latency or NIC bandwidth.
CPU stack and scheduling profiles cover different rounds and short windows, not simultaneous full-round measurements.
Running context-switch residency includes possible spin/poll and DPC/ISR time; it is not useful work. No waiting stacks or allocator event tracing.
Low ML-DSA presence on the ingress thread does not measure worker/device cryptography or prove/disprove asset GPU execution.
No full historical 12K-versus-current causal decomposition or performance improvement is established by this diagnosis.
